title: Inner-anodyne changes of index preserve pointwise left Kan cocones
statement: Use quasicategories, coherent transformations, functor simplicial sets and colimiting cocones of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], and inner anodyne maps in the lifting sense of [lem-coef-inner-anodyne-pushout-product], in a sufficiently large fixed universe. Let $i:L\hookrightarrow K$ be an inner anodyne map of small simplicial sets; neither $L$ nor $K$ need be a quasicategory. Let $C,D$ be quasicategories, $\delta:K\to C$ and $F_0:K\to D$ diagrams, $F:C\to D$ a functor, and $\beta:F_0\to F\delta$ a coherent transformation. For $c\in C$, write $K_{/c}=K\times_C C_{/c}$ and $L_{/c}=L\times_C C_{/c}$, where $C_{/c}$ has simplices $\Delta^n\star\Delta^0\to C$ ending at $c$ and is projected by the entire first face. The canonical cocone on $K_{/c}$ has legs $F_0(k)\xrightarrow{\beta_k}F(\delta k)\xrightarrow{F(u)}F(c)$; the cocone on $L_{/c}$ is its restriction, with the same apex $F(c)$. The cocones on $K_{/c}$ are colimiting for every $c$ if and only if their restrictions on $L_{/c}$ are colimiting for every $c$.

source.place: Kerodon Proposition 7.3.1.14 (02YL), left Kan extension clause, specialized to inner anodyne maps; used in the opening reduction of Proposition 7.3.6.1 (0309). Read online; archival copy WANTED. Kerodon identifiers, not Stacks tags.
